terminals.name: homepage-dev
terminals.description: Vite dev server for the sibling marketing homepage on http://127.0.0.1:5173/. Idles with a message when the homepage repo is not checked out.
terminals.command: HOMEPAGE_ROOT="$(cd .. 2>/dev/null && pwd)/qube-machine-report-homepage"; if [ -f "$HOMEPAGE_ROOT/package.json" ]; then cd "$HOMEPAGE_ROOT" && npm run dev -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5173; else echo '[homepage-dev] qube-machine-report-homepage not checked out in this workspace; nothing to serve.'; fi
